ad_library.summary: One direct Meta ad card was captured; current status and source date require rechecking. Website observations are separate and limited.

rows: The ad card shows the services URL; the linked page lists treatments.
Booking and branch WhatsApp links are shown; no appointment or message was submitted.
The ad mentions KPHB and Nallagandla as well as Vijayawada.

issues: The ad names several locations and phone numbers; routing to the intended branch has not been tested.
The linked services page offers booking and branch WhatsApp links; successful handoff is unverified.
Healthcare claims, consent and measurement require specialist and account review.
wins: The captured ad card links to the services page.
The services page offers booking and branch-specific WhatsApp links.

promise_gap: Ad lists Vijayawada and Hyderabad contacts.
The services page lists treatments and branch WhatsApp links. Branch routing and appointment completion remain untested.
recommended_steps: With clinic permission, verify the services-to-appointment journey on mobile.
Confirm messages and calls reach the intended location and receive follow-up.
Have the clinic check claims and privacy practices; compliance was not assessed here.
Check consent and conversion events in the clinic accounts and browser.

provisional_source_observation.scope: Static source only; execution, event delivery and account configuration not tested.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
